paths.description: Public R18 group gateway and primary choice of reading service; covers the landing template, navigation, preferences, mobile rendering, metadata, performance and security.
Mandatory age-confirmation journey reached from publication, forum and Nocturne destinations; represents the shared restricted-content gate and primary flow.
Invalid URL used to inspect HTTP/navigation failure messaging and recovery options.

findings.summary: The landing page ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical in size to the light screenshot, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal with the body still rgb(241, 243, 245).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define preference-driven surface, text, link, and control colours using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly with no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The feature probe found no authored view-transition rules while the primary actions are full-page links to the three reading services.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for persistent navigation, with reduced-motion-safe styling.

findings.summary: Mobile rendering uses desktop-width or zoom-restricting viewport policies, leaving important text and targets too small.
findings.evidence: At 360x800 the landing screenshot renders a 1088px desktop canvas scaled to 0.331; its meta viewport is width=1088, maximum-scale=1.0. Lighthouse also fails meta-viewport on the mobile variant for user-scalable=no, and the age gate has no viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 without maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions; replace fixed widths with fluid intrinsic layouts and keep controls at least 44 CSS px.

findings.summary: The simple text landing page paints too slowly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP/LCP at 4.0s and Speed Index at 6.8s (performance 0.73); the independent trace measured LCP 4.89s. CLS and TBT were good.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce TTFB and render delay, inline or prioritise the small critical stylesheet, and defer non-critical scripts so text can paint immediately.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking legacy libraries dominate a page that has almost no interaction.
findings.evidence: HAR records 144KB of script in a 218KB load, led by parser-inserted jQuery UI 1.12.1 (84KB) and jQuery 1.12.4 (40KB), with eight confirmed parser-blocking CSS/script candidates and no async/defer attributes in the DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove jQuery UI and unused global bundles from this static landing template; replace the remaining behaviour with small native modules loaded with defer.

findings.summary: The user-registration control does not meet minimum text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse/axe measured white text on #ff922b at 2.23:1 for 14px text, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the orange control background or use dark text until normal-size text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every state.

findings.summary: The document lacks a main landmark and starts its content hierarchy at h2.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no main element and no h1; Lighthouse independently failed landmark-one-main. Keyboard focus itself had a visible auto outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the unique page content in <main> and make its page title an <h1>, preserving the visible focus treatment and logical source order.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals do not consistently describe the public URL set.
findings.evidence: The requested host 302s to nl.syosetu.com, but the final page has no canonical link; /sitemap.xml returns 404. robots.txt is available and does not generally block indexing.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a canonical URL on each public template and expose a sitemap containing canonical URLs, then reference it from robots.txt.

findings.summary: The public landing page has no social preview or structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found zero Open Graph properties and zero JSON-LD blocks despite the page describing the three R18 services and their operator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate og:title, og:description, og:url and preview image metadata, plus Organization/WebSite JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but key browser-enforced security headers and conservative cookie attributes are missing.
findings.evidence: The final response exposes X-Frame-Options: sameorigin, but no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Cookies are Secure, but both are reported SameSite=None and the year-long ks2 cookie is script-readable.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; use Lax/Strict and HttpOnly wherever cross-site or script access is not required.

findings.summary: The required age-confirmation journey depends on JavaScript and cookies instead of a real navigable action.
findings.evidence: The age page explicitly says JavaScript and cookies are required; its “Enter” action is href="javascript:void(0)" with the destination only in data-url. A non-JS crawler therefore cannot follow the adult confirmation path.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real form or href destination handled server-side, with JavaScript only enhancing the transition; preserve the age decision using a progressively enhanced cookie/session.

findings.summary: Google Analytics loads on the mandatory age-confirmation screen before the user chooses a path.
findings.evidence: The age-gate DOM includes an async googletagmanager.com gtag script and immediately runs gtag config, while the home tracker capture otherwise found no known tracker.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load analytics on the mandatory gate by default; if measurement is necessary, minimise it, respect consent and privacy signals, and defer/batch it after an informed action.

findings.summary: The age-confirmation template has a title but no meta description.
findings.evidence: DOM capture of representative publication, forum and reading destinations consistently landed on the age template; its head contains <title>年齢確認</title> but no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, page-specific meta description explaining the age decision and destination context.

findings.summary: The landing template ships obsolete jQuery and jQuery UI releases.
findings.evidence: DOM source loads jQuery 1.12.4 and jQuery UI 1.12.1 synchronously; these legacy branches are unnecessary for the observed static landing experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the legacy dependencies from this template and use current platform APIs; if a library remains necessary, update it and continuously scan dependency advisories.
